title: Great app, but i wish it was more customizable.
body:
For instance i wish i could just dot off more habits in the widget section when im in homescreen and not only one at a time!
And also have a customizable version where i can see multiple of the habits im tracking on one calender in rows. So you see the whole week and all the habits are in columns with the whole week laid out instead of a month.
author: Bonquva
